_README: SNAPSHOT FALLBACK. This is a real captured response from the Open-Meteo CAMS air-quality feed for Central Delhi (28.6448, 77.2167), saved so the demo and tests run with no network. It is MODELED data (CAMS grid, ~11 km), NOT a station measurement, exactly like the live feed. Attribution: Open-Meteo.com from CAMS, CC-BY 4.0.
_note_on_nulls: Hours 03 and 04 have null pm2_5 on purpose: they exercise null handling. A null means 'no reading', never zero. The last two hours are all-null and are dropped entirely.
